hypotheses.title: Customer Return Momentum Mean Reversion with Linear Decay Smoothing
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Refines the supply chain customer return reversal anomaly by replacing equal-weighted rectangular rolling sums with linearly decayed weights (ts_decay_linear). This smoothly weights recent customer performance higher while mitigating abrupt edge drops from finite lookback windows, filtering high-frequency noise and lowering portfolio turnover.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if linear decay increases turnover or if customer return mean-reversion dissipates faster than the decay window.

candidates.rationale: 10-day linearly decayed customer return reversal with 5-day backfill
20-day extended linearly decayed customer return reversal for lower turnover
